segments.t: At the bar, Max coachingly whispers to Nastya to ask the masseur on the phone whether he offers anything intimate besides massage. When the masseur replies that they can arrange anything if she is pretty, Max grabs a bottle of wine and tricks reception into giving him Vika's room key.

Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Hello. Yes, all kinds of massage.' The grammar packs 'hello' and 'massage' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Ask about intimacy!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'ask'. Nastya answers right away.
'And besides massage, anything intimate?' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'besides' in a few short words.

'Miss, well if you are pretty, then you and I will agree on everything.' Kostya anchors the line on 'miss', while 'will come to an agreement' completes the thought.
'Hang up the phone!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'receiver' and finishing on 'put down'. Nastya answers right away.
'Thank you very much, I will call you back.' Nastya anchors the line on 'thank you', while 'will call back' completes the thought.
'I did not get that, what do you mean 'I will call you back'?' Kostya anchors the line on 'not', while 'will call back' completes the thought.
'Well it was just a figure of speech!' Nastya anchors the line on 'come on', while 'had to' completes the thought. Max answers right away.
'Where are they heading, huh?' In Russian, the idea of 'where to' flows naturally into 'and' without extra filler words.
'Vika said that she would book a room.' The meaning hinges on 'Vika' working together with 'will rent' in spoken Russian.

'Viktoriya Sergeyevna asked me to take this wine to the room she booked.' Max pairs 'asked' with 'filmed, took a video of' directly, since spoken Russian skips English filler words like 'the', 'a', and 'is'.
'Give me the key, please!' Max brings out the contrast between 'give' and 'key' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
